context.surface: An installation CLI uses configured names when generating local files and cluster configuration.
assumptions: Use disposable local fixtures and synthetic inputs.

review.invariant: Generated resource filenames use validated basenames within the output directory.
review.verification: Exercise the configuration validation for accepted resource names and values rejected by the basename policy.

source_observation.summary: The baseline accepted names outside the file naming policy. The repaired checks rejected them and preserved the ordinary resource control.
